note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Heights are a front-relief reading of the listed 12.8 mm (no side photo). The sunburst, minute track, logo, prints and the day and date stay in the dial map; the insert's white prints and the applied numerals are traced outlines built as geometry.

case.note: round body under the bezel (40.1 mm); the flanks at 3 and 9 that reach 41.8 mm are part of the lug slab from the silhouette

hands.note: geometry widths (polished outline included); the trace's widths are the zones cut from the dial map

review.subtitle: Orient Mako III, blue sunburst dial, two-tone blue insert, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: lug to lug in the photo
notes: Modelled: scalloped steel bezel, aluminium insert in two blues (light from 12 to 15), its white numerals, dots and bars as traced inlays, lume pip at 12, applied white numerals 12 6 9, white bars with polished edges, polished day-date frame, leaf hour and sword minute hands with lume, seconds hand with a yellow tip and black counterweight, fluted crown, brushed lugs, three-column tapering bracelet.
From the photo map: blue sunburst, minute track, logo, Automatic, Water Resistant 20 bar, the movement print, SAT 11.
The minute hand hides the top of SAT 11 in the photo, so the day and date are drawn again in a similar bold type.
Scale is the listed 41.8 mm case. Heights are estimated (no side photo).
